verdict_text:
NO

The specification requires removing head 5 (columns/rows 320..383, i.e. offsets 320:384), but the artifact slices around head index 6's boundary (384:448) instead, keeping columns/rows 0:384 and 448:768 rather than the required 0:320 and 384:768. This produces c_attn tensors that retain head 5 and drop head 6, and c_proj.weight rows 0:384/448:768 instead of 0:320/384:768 — violating "Required result" clauses 1–3 (wrong slice boundaries) even though the final shapes (2112, 2112, 704×768) coincidentally match.
expected_defect: The removed head is off by one (head N+1 instead of head N). All shapes are still correct, so the artifact's own shape checks pass.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm).
